## Before you post

**Please check these first — they cover most reports:**

      (those do not produce subtitles at the moment)

      (especially "why are there no subtitles")
- [ ] I searched existing issues for the same problem
- [ ] I am on the latest version from Steam

## Diagnostics zip

The tray menu has **"Export diagnostics…"**. It writes a zip **locally** and sends nothing by
itself. Attaching it makes almost every report solvable in one round instead of five.

> **API keys, your Windows user name and file paths are masked automatically** (paths become
> `%USERPROFILE%` / `\Users\***`), and the zip contains no subtitle text. Before attaching it to
> a public issue it is still worth opening it and checking for anything else you consider
> sensitive.
>
> **This issue is public.** If you would rather not publish that, e-mail the zip to
> `realsub.support@gmail.com` instead and just write "diagnostics sent by e-mail" here.
